newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hyundai Int'l Merchant Bank to set US$70 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Int'l Merchant Bank to set US$70 mln FRCD.

text.p: Hyundai International Merchant Bank has mandated three banks to arrange a US$70 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said.
They said the issue size could be increased up to a maximum of US$100 million in case of oversubscription.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options.
The issue will be priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Management fees are 48 basis points for an all-in return of 66 basis points to the expanded arranger group.
At present, a total of US$45 million has been underwritten. An expanded arranger group is being sought.
The three mandated arrangers are Bank Gesellschaft Berlin Group, Credit Lyonnais Hong Kong and Hanil Bank.
